job.title: AWS Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Senior AWS DevOps Engineer - 6 months - London/hybrid - £475 - 500 - urgent (needs to start within 2 weeks max.)
Required Technical Skills
  • Strong hands-on experience with core AWS services such as EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, Route 53, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
  • Advanced experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform.
  • Strong CI/CD expertise with Jenkins or comparable pipeline platforms, including automated quality gates and deployment controls.
  • Proficiency in Scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell or a similar language.
  • Practical experience with Git-based source control, branching strategies and collaborative code-review practices.
  • Experience with Linux administration and working knowledge of Windows-based cloud workloads.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes-based platforms such as Amazon EKS, or AWS-native container services such as ECS.
  • Good understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and secure configuration.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and incident-response capabilities for cloud platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.
Key Responsibilities
  • Personally design, provision, configure and maintain highly available, scalable and secure AWS environments; validate implementations against enterprise standards and AWS Well-Architected principles.
  • Write, test, review and maintain reusable infrastructure-as-code modules using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, including state management, versioning and automated validation.
  • Build, enhance and support CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline or equivalent.
  • Automate application build, test, deployment, configuration and release processes across multiple environments.
  • Design and operate containerised platforms using Docker, Amazon ECS and/or Amazon EKS, including deployment patterns, scaling and platform upgrades.
  • Implement AWS networking and security controls, including VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, IAM roles and policies, encryption, secrets management and multi-account governance.
  • Establish monitoring, logging, alerting and observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail and suitable enterprise tooling.
  • Improve platform reliability through capacity planning, backup, disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability remediation and operational readiness practices.
  • Support application and infrastructure migration from on-premises or hybrid environments to AWS, including assessment, landing-zone preparation, cutover and post-migration optimisation.
  • Independently investigate complex infrastructure, deployment, performance, security and availability issues by analysing logs, metrics, configurations and code; complete root-cause analysis, implement the fix and drive preventive actions through to closure.
  • Partner with developers, architects, security teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical cloud solutions.
  • Create and maintain high-level designs, detailed technical documentation, runbooks, standards and migration records.
  • Provide technical guidance, code and design reviews, mentoring and continuous-improvement leadership across the engineering team.
  • Evaluate platform usage and cost, recommend right-sizing and optimisation opportunities, and support effective cloud governance.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  • Experience designing hybrid-cloud solutions and integrating AWS with on-premises data centres.
  • Knowledge of configuration-management tools such as Ansible, Chef or Puppet.
  • Experience with microservices, platform engineering, PaaS environments and service integration.
  • Understanding of SRE practices, service-level objectives, error budgets and resilience engineering.
  • Experience supporting cloud assessments, architecture reviews, audits, RFP responses or pre-sales solutioning.
  • AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional.
  • Exposure to other cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is advantageous.

job.title: AWS Solution Architect
job.description:
AWS Solution Architect - Cambridge (2 days a week)
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to design and lead the implementation of scalable, cloud-native systems on AWS. You will work across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to define architecture for distributed microservices platforms powered by event-driven patterns - translating complex requirements into resilient, production-grade solutions.
Architecture Design & Governance
  • Define end-to-end system architectures aligned with business goals and engineering capabilities.
  • Establish and enforce design principles, architectural standards, and best practices.
  • Conduct architecture reviews, threat modelling sessions, and design critiques.
  • Own and maintain technical roadmaps across multiple product domains.
Microservices Strategy
  • Lead service decomposition efforts using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
  • Define domain boundaries, bounded contexts, and inter-service communication contracts.
  • Design RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs with a focus on backward compatibility and versioning.
  • Set patterns for service resilience: circuit breakers, retries, bulkheads, and rate limiting.
  • Establish observability standards: distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics.
Event-Driven Architecture
  • Design event streaming and async messaging systems using Apache Kafka, Amazon SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Kinesis.
  • Define and enforce event schema standards and schema evolution strategies.
  • Implement event sourcing, CQRS, and saga orchestration patterns where appropriate.
  • Govern event-driven data flows across bounded contexts and third-party integrations.
AWS Cloud Engineering
  • Design AWS infrastructure using EKS, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, and VPC networking.
  • Define Infrastructure as Code (IaC) standards using Terraform and/or AWS CDK.
  • Oversee multi-account AWS organisation structure, landing zones, and guardrails (AWS Control Tower).
  • Lead cloud migration and modernisation initiatives from on-premise to AWS.
Stakeholder Engagement
  • Partner with engineering leads, product managers, and C-suite to align technical strategy with business objectives.
  • Present architecture proposals, trade-off analyses, and risk assessments to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to external clients or partners where required.
  • Mentor and upskill senior engineers on architecture patterns and cloud-native practices.
Security, Reliability & Cost
  • Embed security into architecture from day one: IAM, KMS, WAF, AWS Shield, and secrets management.
  • Design for reliability using multi-AZ deployments, DR strategies, and defined SLAs/SLOs.
  • Drive FinOps practices: right-sizing, reserved capacity planning, and cloud cost optimisation.

job.title: Quality Engineering (QE) Architect/Lead
job.description:
Quality Engineering (QE) Architect/Lead - York (2/3 days) - 12 months
Role
QE Architect is the strategic and hands-on Quality Engineering leader responsible for defining, architecting, and governing the enterprise-wide quality engineering capability across the Tech Transformation portfolio. The role enables a product-led delivery model by embedding continuous testing, automation-first, shift-left quality practices, risk-based assurance, and flow engineering principles throughout the software development life cycle.
Experience & Qualifications
  • 12+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Engineering or Test Automation.
  • Minimum 5 years' operating as QE Architect/Principal Quality Engineer or Enterprise QE Lead level.
  • Proven experience designing and scaling enterprise automation frameworks.
  • Demonstrable expertise implementing Quality Engineering capabilities across large transformation portfolios.
  • Strong experience with cloud, APIs, enterprise integration and data platform testing.
  • Experience supporting Agile, Product-led and DevOps delivery models.
  • Experience implementing TDD, BDD and Continuous Testing practices.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Insurance or highly regulated industries preferred.
Key Responsibilities
1. QE Strategy, Architecture & Transformation
  • Define and maintain the Tech Transformation Quality Engineering Architecture and target-state quality operating model.
  • Establish enterprise standards for automation, continuous testing, quality gates, test observability, and release assurance.
  • Drive adoption of engineering-led quality practices aligned to DevOps and Flow Engineering principles.
  • Design scalable QE frameworks that support Digital, Workbench, Data, AI and Integration platforms.
  • Define and govern end-to-end integration testing to ensure seamless data flow, business process integrity, and operational reliability across core Policy, Claims, D365, Power Platform, API, and downstream enterprise systems
  • Create reusable quality engineering assets, accelerators and reference architectures to increase delivery efficiency across programmes.
  • Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Product leadership to embed quality from ideation through production.
2. Automation Architecture & Continuous Testing
  • Architect and evolve enterprise automation frameworks covering UI, API, Data, Integration, AI and Non-Functional testing.
  • Drive automation-first delivery ensuring automated validation is Embedded throughout CI/CD pipelines.
  • Define testing strategies across the testing pyramid, ensuring automation is implemented at the most effective layer.
  • Establish standards for:
  • UI automation
  • API automation
  • Contract testing
  • Data quality testing
  • Integration testing
  • Accessibility testing
  • Performance testing
  • Security testing
  • AI model validation
  • Promote Test Driven Development (TDD), Behaviour Driven Development (BDD), Specification by Example and Shift-Left testing practices.
  • Design quality engineering solutions supporting feature teams, platform teams and product squads.
3. AI-Led Quality Engineering
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted and Agentic Testing capabilities.
  • Define enterprise standards for AI-generated test design, test automation generation, self-healing automation and intelligent defect analysis.
  • Drive effective use of GitHub Copilot, Claude and future AI engineering assistants.
  • Establish approaches for ML model validation, prompt testing, AI workflow assurance and responsible AI testing.
  • Identify opportunities to improve QE productivity through AI-driven risk analysis and predictive quality insights.
4. Technology & Platform Quality Architecture
Own quality engineering strategy and architecture across:
Digital CX Platforms
  • OutSystems
Business Applications
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Microsoft Power Platform
Data & Analytics Platforms
  • GCP-based solutions
  • SQL platforms
  • AI product ecosystems
  • Power BI
Integration Platforms
  • Azure APIM
  • Event-driven integrations
AI & Intelligent Products
  • Underwriting Intelligence solutions
  • ML-powered products
  • Email Intake and Fraud/Coverage Assessment platforms
5. Engineering Excellence & Governance
  • Define enterprise quality KPIs and engineering metrics.
  • Establish quality governance processes supporting risk-based decision making.
  • Define release readiness standards and quality gates.
  • Provide independent assurance for high-risk and business-critical initiatives.
  • Lead defect prevention strategies using root cause analysis and quality trend insights.
  • Standardise reporting using Power BI, Allure, Azure DevOps dashboards.
  • Ensure regulatory, audit and operational risk requirements are appropriately addressed.
6. Capability Building & Technical Leadership
  • Act as the senior technical authority for Quality Engineering across the Tech Transformation portfolio.
  • Coach and mentor QE Leads, SDETs, Automation Engineers and programme test teams.
  • Develop engineering communities, standards and knowledge-sharing practices.
  • Drive adoption of modern testing approaches across Product, Engineering and Delivery teams.
  • Build internal capability and reduce dependency on external suppliers through coaching and framework reuse.
  • Promote consistent engineering practices across all delivery teams.
Required Technical Expertise
Programming Languages
Deep hands-on expertise in:
  • TypeScript, JavaScript, C#
  • Python, PyTest, SQL
Strong understanding of:
  • Object-oriented programming
  • API development and testing
  • Data engineering concepts
  • Cloud-native architectures
  • Microservices architectures
Automation & Testing Tools
UI Automation

  • Cucumber/Reqnroll
API Automation

Email Services

Data Testing

Performance & NFR

Delivery & DevOps

  • Azure Repos, Pipelines
  • Jira, Xray
Reporting & Observability

AI Engineering

  • Agentic AI Testing Solutions

job.title: Enterprise Architect/Lead Enterprise Architect
job.description:
Enterprise Architect/Lead Enterprise Architect - London (may be 1-2 days a week) and remote - global payments organisation!

Role
You will be high-calibre, technically broad Lead Enterprise Architect (EA). In this role, you will be the architectural anchor for a high-priority transformation portfolio: designing the multi-year infrastructure roadmap, driving the End-of-Life (EOL) decommissioning and re-platforming pipeline, and providing technical governance for our Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) remediation program. Combine deep infrastructure engineering with financial discipline, embedding FinOps frameworks across cloud and on-premise environments (ensure that every milestone on the strategic roadmap optimizes unit economics, eliminates waste during EOL migrations, and remains tightly aligned with corporate fiscal and security goals).
Core Key Responsibilities
  • Architect the target-state vision for a highly resilient hybrid environment, seamlessly blending on-premise data centers with multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Assist in pre-sales as well as delivering IT roadmap created to remediated client Legacy environment into cloud-based environment where possible. This means person should possess skills to design AWS and Azure environments along with required security (IAM, Defender, Sentinel and PAM tools). Client is expecting for ISO27001 auditing. Infrastructure applications like Backup, Monitoring, Route 53 and Domain controllers along with EUC tools like InTune are the getting migrated as part of the project. Business application migration is out of scope.
  • Build & Govern the Strategic Roadmap: Design and maintain a phased, multi-year technology life cycle roadmap tracking infrastructure dependencies, technical debt, and aggressive EOL asset mitigation.
  • Drive FinOps & Cost Optimization: Establish cloud financial accountability by embedding FinOps practices into the architecture life cycle. Manage cloud spend, model TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) for EOL re-platforming options, and eliminate Legacy waste.
  • Champion ITDR Remediation: Provide primary technical and architectural governance for the Identity Threat Detection and Response program. Harden hybrid identity environments across Active Directory and cloud IDPs (Entra ID).
  • Guide & Influence Engineering Teams: Act as the ultimate technical bridge across diverse infrastructure silos (Compute, Storage, Network, IAM, Cloud). Confidently guide engineering execution toward compliant, budget-aware target states.
Technical Skills & Domain Expertise
1. Hybrid & Multi-Cloud Architecture
  • Extensive experience designing, deploying, and migrating applications across hybrid environments (On-Premises to Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong grasp of container orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) to ensure consistency across cloud environments.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale infrastructure decommissioning, hardware refreshes, and Legacy system modernization.
2. FinOps & Financial Modeling/Financials
  • Deep familiarity with the FinOps Framework (Inform, Optimize, Operate phases) and cloud cost management tooling (eg, AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, CloudHealth, Kubecost).
  • Capability to design architectures optimized for cost efficiency, incorporating spot instances, savings plans, auto-scaling parameters, and data egress optimization.
  • Strong capability to calculate TCO and ROI comparison models, guiding the team to select the most cost-effective cloud or hybrid landing zones for migrating EOL systems.
3. Identity & Cyber Resilience (ITDR Focus)
  • Advanced architectural knowledge of hybrid Identity & Access Management (IAM) ecosystems, including Active Directory tiering models, Entra ID, and PAM solutions (CyberArk, BeyondTrust).
  • Understanding of identity threat vectors and security posture assessment tools designed to detect privilege escalation, lateral movement, and misconfigurations.
Leadership & Strategy Capabilities
  • Financial & Technical Diplomat: Able to effectively bridge the gap between Enterprise IT Engineering, Finance (CFO office), and Procurement to drive cultural accountability around cloud spend.
  • Risk-Aware Decision Maker: Competent at balancing the urgency of security remediation (ITDR) and EOL risk management against immediate financial constraints and operational SLAs.
  • Architectural Communicator: Expert visual modeler (Miro, Visio, ArchiMate) capable of distilling complex infrastructure topologies and financial metrics into clear executive roadmaps.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience: Total of 15+ years of experience with 8+ years in an Enterprise, Cloud, or Infrastructure Architecture leadership role driving large hybrid cloud transformations.
  • Certifications (Highly Regarded):
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Enterprise Architect.
  • TOGAF, Zachman, or SAFe framework certifications.
  • Professional Cloud Architect certifications (eg, AWS Certified Solutions Architect Pro, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect).
